waterway_forest_isolated_man.m: What were you doing in my house!
r: I've come a long distance in the persuit of my brother Andor. So I peeked inside to see if he was in there.
I am looking for someone that could explain why that land over there [pointing west] is poisoned.
I was looking for help in getting into that cave just west of here.

waterway_forest_isolated_man_5.m: Do you really think that I believe that? Who are you?! What do you really want?!
r: I don't care what you don't believe because that's the truth.
Can you just answer my question now or I will go back in your house?

waterway_forest_isolated_man_dog.m: Well, with that attitude, you better get out of here now before I unleash my hounds on you.
